literal_meaning: There is no word or speech
figurative_meaning_en: There is no objection or protest
example_sentences_in_bangla: শ্বশুরবাড়িতে কত গঞ্জনা সত্ত্বেও তার মুখে কথাটি নেই।
চাকরিতে অনেক চাপ পড়লেও সে কথাটি নেই বলে কাজ করে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Despite all the teasing at her in-laws' house, she had not a word of protest.
Even under heavy pressure at work, he carried on without a single complaint.
note: Often used in contexts highlighting traditional gender roles in Bengali families
